structured_output.mechanisms: Time ≈ steps × per-step cost, which is affine in stage widths (c1, c2 dominate), sublinear in batch size, reduced by low-resolution phases (about 0.82× at 50%), plus Muon overhead. Accuracy rises about 0.6 points per epoch near 11 epochs and falls with narrower widths, cutout, translate4, random flip, label smoothing away from 0.1, and the low-res fraction. Muon adds about 0.8 points.
